You read that right.
She swallowed the cash…
with help from coworkers who handed her water to wash it down.
No escape plan.
No exit strategy.
Just raw desperation and a hope it’d reappear in a toilet bowl two days later.
They didn’t just fire her.
They banned pockets in the entire airport.
